title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Psalms 24: the earth belonging to Yahweh, who may stand in his holy place, and the gates lifted up for the King of glory.

questions.text: According to verse 1, to whom does the earth belong?
questions.explanation: Psalms 24:1 says, 'The earth is Yahweh's, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.'

questions.text: On what has he founded the earth?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says he has founded it on the seas and established it on the floods.

questions.text: In verse 3, to what place does the psalmist ask who may ascend?
questions.explanation: Psalms 24:3 asks, 'Who may ascend to Yahweh's hill? Who may stand in his holy place?'

questions.text: Besides clean hands, what must the one who ascends have?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, 'He who has clean hands and a pure heart.'

questions.text: What else is said in verse 4 about the one who may stand in the holy place?
questions.explanation: Psalms 24:4 says he has not lifted up his soul to falsehood and has not sworn deceitfully.

answers.text: He has fasted for many days
He has fought in many battles

questions.text: What shall he receive from Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says, 'He shall receive a blessing from Yahweh, righteousness from the God of his salvation.'

questions.text: What name is given to the generation of those who seek his face?
questions.explanation: Psalms 24:6 says, 'This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face - even Jacob.'

questions.text: Who are told to lift up their heads?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says, 'Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors.'

questions.text: How is the King of glory described in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Psalms 24:8 answers, 'Yahweh strong and mighty, Yahweh mighty in battle.'

answers.text: Strong and mighty, mighty in battle

questions.text: According to the last verse, who is the King of glory?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says, 'Yahweh of Armies is the King of glory!'
